DERIVATION is core model s3 pattern 1: data/spain_2014_volunteering.do infixes DA3039 at the ES3039 DATA LIST positions (P10A01..P10A16 = cols 73-88, identical to the questionnaire's P.10a column codes (73)-(88); P10A17 'Otra' col 89 is not in the table) under lower-cased names, and Bookmark 3 sets item = the variable name -- nothing positional, so Step 5b is exempt and no verification_/verify_ files were written. LABELS vs QUESTIONNAIRE: ES3039 VARIABLE LABELS P10A01-P10A16 compared with the P.10/P.10a grid rows of cues3039.pdf page 2 (text layer, checked against a 110-dpi render), dot leaders dropped and the two hyphenated line breaks rejoined ('asisten-/cial', 'organiza-/ción'): 16/16 agree character for character (asserted in build.R); the P1001-P1016 labels are the same 16 strings. VALUE LABELS identical on all 16: 0 'No procede' 1 'Sí' 2 'No' 9 'N.C.'; option_text = 'Sí'/'No' (the grid's column heads read 'Sí No NC'). RESP BY DESIGN: the .do recodes 0 (No procede) and 9 (N.C.) to missing, so live resp is {1,2}, 1 = Sí. Filter is exact: P10A==0 iff the same association's P10 is 3 (never belonged) or 9, 0 mismatches on all 16 items. Code 9 dropped per item p10a01..p10a16: 94/53/47/48/36/38/37/28/25/33/32/51/32/31/31/26. p10a16 (Feminista) has 0 Sí of 9, so that item uses only resp 2 in the data. CHECKED, decisive: reading DA3039 (id = row number) at cols 73-88, dropping 0/9 as the .do does, cov_sex col 165 (P34, 1 Hombre/2 Mujer) and cov_age cols 159-160 (P31, 99 -> NA), reproduces the live table exactly: 1841 rows both, 788 ids both, 0 only-live / 0 only-rebuilt rows, 0 resp / 0 cov_sex / 0 cov_age mismatches. CONTENT MISMATCH (Step 3b, overriding the .do comment and the IRW dictionary): the .do header ('yes/no active participation in each association the respondent belongs or belonged to') and the dictionary Description ('Whether respondent participates or participated actively in association types') do not describe these columns. The questionnaire's P.10a, printed at column codes (73)-(89), asks whether each association the respondent belongs/belonged to 'es/era una asociación específicamente juvenil' -- is/was specifically a youth association. Degree of participation is P.11, a single question (col 90, ES3039 label 'Grado de participación en asociaciones juveniles', 1 'Como miembro activo...' .. 4 'mero simpatizante'), not a per-association battery, and is not in this table. The data fit the questionnaire reading: Sí share Estudiantil 86.0% (135/157), Excursionista 58.8%, Deportiva 56.9%, vs Sindical 7.7% (2/26), Benéfica 17.7%, Partido 20.0%, Asociación o colegio profesional 20.5%, Feminista 0/9; and pooled over items former members (P10=2) say Sí 530/1055 = 50.2% vs current members (P10=1) 320/786 = 40.7%, the reverse of what an 'active participation' item would show. instrument names P.10a accordingly; the table name '_activity' and the dictionary Description should be corrected (not done here). The response data themselves are correct (exact rebuild); only the label is wrong. validate_items.R --table-sets passed (16 items, resp {1,2}). TEXT (text_source=study_materials): instructions = the P.10a question verbatim from cues3039.pdf including its printed interviewer filter '(Hacer sólo si responde 1 ó 2 en cada asociación)', shared by all 16 rows, so instructions not section_prompt, one trivial section; the P.10 membership stem is not repeated (it belongs to sibling _membership). translation_source=machine_translation: CIS publishes Estudio 3039 in Spanish only; the _translated columns are English written by this project -- issues-page line owed at upload.
